title: Global AI Career Radar
description: Ad-hoc exploration of the job database. See the Streamlit dashboard for the ranked candidate view.

ranked.title: APPLY / CONSIDER, ranked by score
ranked.sql: SELECT round(coalesce(llm_score, rule_score)) AS score, coalesce(llm_verdict, recommendation) AS verdict, country, title, company, coalesce(llm_reasoning, reason) AS why, replace(gaps, '|', '; ') AS gaps, url FROM jobs WHERE coalesce(llm_verdict, recommendation) IN ('APPLY', 'CONSIDER') ORDER BY score DESC

to_score.title: Jobs awaiting LLM scoring (rule_score >= 40, no llm_score)
to_score.sql: SELECT round(rule_score) AS rule_score, country, title, company, replace(strengths, '|', '; ') AS strengths, url FROM jobs WHERE llm_score IS NULL AND rule_score >= 40 ORDER BY rule_score DESC

by_source.title: Jobs per source, with average score and scored count
by_source.sql: SELECT source, count(*) AS jobs, sum(llm_score IS NOT NULL) AS llm_scored, round(avg(coalesce(llm_score, rule_score)), 1) AS avg_score FROM jobs GROUP BY source ORDER BY jobs DESC

verdicts_by_country.title: Verdict breakdown by country
verdicts_by_country.sql: SELECT country, coalesce(llm_verdict, recommendation, 'UNSCORED') AS verdict, count(*) AS n FROM jobs GROUP BY country, verdict ORDER BY country, n DESC

search_description.title: Full-text-ish search of the job description
search_description.sql: SELECT round(coalesce(llm_score, rule_score)) AS score, country, title, company, url FROM jobs WHERE lower(title || ' ' || company || ' ' || description) LIKE '%' || lower(:term) || '%' ORDER BY score DESC
